# blazor-blog-feature

Adds a complete blog feature to an existing Blazor WebAssembly Static Web App with Azure Functions backend and Azure File Share for markdown storage. Use when implementing blog functionality in .NET Blazor WASM projects with Azure infrastructure. Includes post listing, detail pages, markdown rendering, Azure Storage integration.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r blazor-blog-feature ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r blazor-blog-feature .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.
